title: You get what you pay for! 5 Star
text:
Our old cat Walter sadly after many years of gastrointestinal illness had to be put to sleep on Tuesday. It was a very sad day for all the family.

We wisely bought a Platinum Lifetime policy  ten years ago and this has always met the many, many £,000’s vet bills over the years.

Any intelligent person would understand that as a pet gets older that there is an increased chance that you may need to claim on the policy and consequently premiums will increase with the pets age. Common sense really.

I vehemently disagree with many of the negative posts made about API as from my experience, with ongoing claims, I have never felt that my premium increases were a stealth way of them trying to recover past claims paid out.

I am a great believer that in life you generally get what you pay for. If you buy cheap insurance (whether pet, travel etc etc) without reading what is covered and the indemnity limits and clauses, more fool you.

Submitted last claim of £2.2k Tuesday approved 2 days later on Thursday. Excellent service and thank you.

Without reservation I recommend Argos Pet Insurance

I would definitely recommend Argos pet insurance after the experience we’ve had.

title: Mixed experience
text:
I've had my cat insured with Argos for 8 years, and it's been a mixed experience. I had to claim for a dental operation and two rounds of blood tests during the time I had the policy, and in fairness, every claim was paid out without argument and often within a couple of days of the claim - the service was great. The portal is not very user-friendly, but it's workable.

However, the premium has jumped by about £90/month over the course of the time I've been with Argos, finally coming in at £110/month, which for a cat who, although elderly, is generally healthy, is vast. There was absolutely no attempt to retain me as a customer or offer me an alternative deal - the vibe seemed to be that they were happy to insure her whilst she was young, but once she hit 13, they wanted to get rid of us as customers, and kept jumping the premiums up to find the tipping point.

Really disappointed in this as Argos has had thousands of pounds from me over the years, and it would have been good to see loyalty from their side.
